content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in South Bend

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background, then contact Granite PM Academy to verify your qualifications. Eligibility confirmation ensures you're ready to proceed without delays.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover all exam domains in real time. This formal education satisfies PMI's prerequisite and prepares you for the exam itself.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP® application, detailing your education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee through PMI's portal. Processing typically takes several business days; plan ahead to secure your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Test your readiness, then sit for the computer-based exam at your convenience.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP® certification lasts three years. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by taking courses, volunteering, or engaging in professional activities. Renew your credential before expiration to keep the PMP® active and demonstrate your commitment to project-management excellence.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
